Description.SourceString: Alchemists and specialists in herbal remedies would be lying if they said they hadn't considered the medicinal properties of Kuldra. They imagine what it would be like if they could get hold of one of her teeth, crush it, and then use it in place of the traditional ground dragon tooth. Just how much of a kick would that give their concoctions? They're self-aware enough to know that it's just a fantasy, but they like to daydream about it anyway. Sure, it would be lovely to rid the world of a tyrant dragon, but think of the potions!
